name: Longevity Codex
detailed_description:
Longevity Codex is a strategy deckbuilding roguelite set in a mystical cultivation world. Train your skills, refine legendary artifacts, tame spirit beasts, and choose your dual cultivation partner as you forge your own path to immortality.

You're not the Chosen One. You're just another soul seeking eternal life in a world ruled by ancient sects, powerful monsters, and unpredictable fates.
Start from humble beginnings with only your spiritual root and a dream. Through clever choices and strategic planning, collect powerful techniques, pills, artifacts, and allies to advance your cultivation and defy the heavens.
Each run is a new journey. With hundreds of unique abilities, random events, and dynamic synergies, no two lifetimes will be the same.

Features

  • 💠 Strategic Deckbuilding Meets Cultivation: Mix and match techniques, artifacts, pills, and spirit beasts to create powerful synergies.

  • 🌙 Multi-stage Cultivation Progression: Advance through realms like Qi Condensation, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, and beyond.

  • ❤️ Dual Cultivation System: Meet and bond with unique partners to share power and tackle greater challenges together.

  • 🐲 Hundreds of Techniques and Items: From righteous path to demonic arts, combine rare treasures and mystical spells to shape your style.

  • 🔥 Dynamic Events and Choices: Every decision can change your fate—from sudden breakthroughs to unexpected tribulations.

Choose your dual cultivation partner and build your path to immortality through a vast array of artifacts, techniques, elixirs, spirit beasts, and more. Break through your limits, defy fate, and ascend to the heavens!
